timing_contract: Author cached spreadsheet percentage from same-row qPCR ratio is the target. No same-time Cp/ratio is a predictor. Use only own replicate22/72-hour percentages to forecast96h and later. Biological replicate pairing from Sample Name.
calibration: p22 and p72 are own-replicate fractions (source percentages/100). Delta=t−72h, and s is early log-odds change per hour. Fractions are clipped to0.0001–0.9999 only for log-odds calculation; original targets are unchanged. The output is100 times logistic(log-odds), in percentage points.75h is a development-selected shape scale. This early/late conditional equation does not estimate an independently measured fitness coefficient.
independent_unit: whole co-cultured strain including every replicate/time

challenger.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the combined branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_constant_selection.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the constant_selection branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_persistence.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the persistence branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_rbf.equation: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.

baseline_residual_rbf.equation: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Shared conditions, sensor/system dependence or small numbers of reserved groups do not support precise population-level confidence. No row-bootstrap intervals.

scope_limits: Two reserved yeast strain labels, eighteen later author-derived qPCR percentages, same experiment campaign with audit-exposed targets; no blind validation or nutrient mechanism identification.

exposure.historical_record: All packaged targets are now exposed; future scoring is retrospective. Schema audit printed first13 spreadsheet rows before model construction, including several later percentages across all strains. Allocation is still metadata-only and no fit/selection uses reserved targets, but confirmation is audit-exposed retrospective evidence, not a fully blind independent confirmation.

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
